QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_29

question.text: The Code of Conduct for Social Impact Assessors typically covers which of the following pillars?

answer.text: Marketing ethics, client acquisition norms and referral-commission disclosures.
Integrity, objectivity, confidentiality, professional behaviour, professional competence and due care, documentation, due diligence and compliance.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 2.2.3 final paragraph, the SIA code focuses on integrity, objectivity, confidentiality, professional behaviour, professional competence and due care, documentation, due diligence and compliance. This mirrors the ICAI Code of Ethics for Chartered Accountants — appropriate since the SRO is under ICAI's aegis. **The Trap:** Options A and C cherry-pick subsets. Option D is distributor-side ethics (V-A), not assessor-side. **Cross-Exam Context:** V-A (MF Distributor) has a code focused on marketing/commission ethics. X-A/X-B (IA) code of conduct most closely resembles SIA's — fiduciary/independent advisor architecture. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Flag any potential conflict of interest (prior consulting for the same NPO, family relationships with promoter/trustees, equity holdings in an SSE-listed FPSE) in your engagement acceptance memo — the SIA code's 'objectivity' pillar requires pre-engagement screening, not post-hoc disclosure.
